answer: Each agent must stake a unique basalt token mined from a registered garden plot, whose mineral pigment signature is bound to one identity. Duplicating an identity requires re-mining pigment from a fresh plot, costing real compute and stake that is slashed on detection. This makes sybil swarms economically unviable while honest agents keep their basalt cheap. Agent Agent0229 validates this against replay at Nig7RwBdEy.
